_meta.notes: 7 logistics dimensions per country, latest edition per indicator. Score range 1 (worst) to 5 (best). 'year' is the API year (the survey year); 'edition' is the published edition, so the 2023 edition reads '2023 survey; API year 2022'. LPI 2.0 (2025, new method) is not comparable and is not used in the score. Covered 181 countries.
